thread_text:
ci-bot: build #4823 failed on integ/session-store with exit 1 — 3 tests failed
maria: noticed recurring failures on that CI job today. seeing lots of "gaierror: [Errno -2] Name or service not known" to mock-auth.local :thinking:
kevin: same. logs show DNS lookup errors (mock-auth.local) and then our session-store test times out waiting for auth callback.
jake: can someone bisect? unsure if this started after networking change in runner image yesterday
anita: I can bisect this morning. quick question — do we have a stable failing commit to start from?
maria: 1785489000 passed, 1785550000 failed — seems to be between those two
anita: ok starting git bisect: `git bisect start 1785550000 1785489000` will run `./ci/run_integ.sh` locally
kevin: fwiw, the flakiness happens only on the linux-xlarge runner, not macos or small. probably overlay CNI issue
maria: can we try rerunning the job with "use-host-dns: true" or disable coredns in the job?
jake: I kicked off a manual rerun with HOST_DNS=1 — builders/4823-rerun
ci-bot: rerun started: build #4823.1
anita: bisect step 1 -> still failing on 4823.1 with same gaierror
anita: skipping bisect for now, I suspect recent image bumped `node-resolver` -> 1.4.3
kevin: since bisect is slow, proposal: temporarily change integ test to fallback to 127.0.0.1 when mock-auth.local fails, then rerun to get green and unblock PRs
maria: prefer not to change tests just to hide infra issue. other option: spin ephemeral mock-auth on loopback using `docker run --network=host mock-auth:latest`
jake: can you run that and point CI job to it? i'd rather not edit tests
maria: on it — launched mock-auth on host, updated test env var MOCK_AUTH_HOST=127.0.0.1, requeued build
ci-bot: rerun started: build #4823.2
kevin: thanks. if that passes, we need an infra ticket to track DNS resolver regression and revert image
ci-bot: build #4823.2 succeeded ✅
jake: nice — thanks maria :tada:
anita: filing infra ticket now — #INF-2137 — mention CNI and node-resolver 1.4.3
maria: assign to @kevin for follow-up on image pin / rollback
kevin: on it, will open PR to pin runner image and add smoke DNS check in preflight
maria: also add a CI retry policy for that job to auto-rerun up to 2 times if DNS lookup fails (temporary)
jake: sounds good. closing the immediate pipeline unblocks PRs. :thumbsup:
maria: leaving note in the failing-job thread and will add repro steps to INF-2137
